import itertools

def get_sign(perm):
    """Calculates the sign of a permutation represented as a tuple."""
    n = len(perm)
    inversions = 0
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if perm[i] > perm[j]:
                inversions += 1
    return 1 if inversions % 2 == 0 else -1

def count_fixed_points(perm):
    """Counts the number of fixed points of a permutation."""
    return sum(1 for i, p in enumerate(perm) if p == i + 1)

def calculate_L_N(N):
    """Calculates L_N = sum_{pi in S_N} sigma(pi) / (v(pi) + 1)."""
    S_N = list(itertools.permutations(range(1, N + 1)))
    L_N = 0
    for pi in S_N:
        sigma = get_sign(pi)
        v_pi = count_fixed_points(pi)
        L_N += sigma / (v_pi + 1)
    return L_N

# Test N=1, 2, 3, 4
L1 = calculate_L_N(1)
L2 = calculate_L_N(2)
L3 = calculate_L_N(3)
L4 = calculate_L_N(4)

print(f"L_1: {L1}")
print(f"L_2: {L2}")
print(f"L_3: {L3}")
print(f"L_4: {L4}")
